intervals/performance/.zattrs.description: behavioral performance for each context block in task (refers to `trials` or `intervals['DynamicRouting1'])

intervals/performance/aud_dprime/.zattrs.description: dprime within auditory modality; hits=response rate to auditory target stimulus, false alarms=response rate to auditory non-target stimulus

intervals/performance/aud_nontarget_resp.description: the proportion of responses the subject made to auditory nontarget stimulus trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/performance/aud_target_respons.description: the proportion of responses the subject made to auditory target stimulus trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/performance/block_index/.zattr.description: presentation position of the block in the task (0-indexed)

intervals/performance/catch_response_rat.description: the proportion of responses the subject made in catch trials in the block

intervals/performance/cross_modality_dpr.description: dprime across modalities; hits=response rate to rewarded target stimulus, false alarms=response rate to non-rewarded target stimulus

intervals/performance/false_alarm_rate/..description: the proportion of incorrect responses the subject made in NOGO trials in the block

intervals/performance/hit_rate/.zattrs.description: the proportion of correct responses the subject made in GO trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/performance/is_first_block_aud.description: whether the rewarded modality of the first block in the task was auditory

intervals/performance/n_contingent_rewar.description: the number of rewards the subject received for correct responses in the block

intervals/performance/n_hits/.zattrs.description: the number of correct responses the subject made in GO trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/performance/n_responses/.zattr.description: the number of responses the subject made in trials in the block

intervals/performance/n_trials/.zattrs.description: the number of trials in the block

intervals/performance/rewarded_modality/.description: the modality of the target stimulus that was rewarded in the block: normally `vis` or `aud`

intervals/performance/signed_cross_modal.description: same as cross_modality_dprime, but with negative values for auditory blocks

intervals/performance/start_time/.zattrs.description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

intervals/performance/stop_time/.zattrs.description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

intervals/performance/vis_dprime/.zattrs.description: dprime within visual modality; hits=response rate to visual target stimulus, false alarms=response rate to visual non-target stimulus

intervals/performance/vis_nontarget_resp.description: the proportion of responses the subject made to visual nontarget stimulus trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/performance/vis_target_respons.description: the proportion of responses the subject made to visual target stimulus trials in the block (excluding trials with scheduled reward)

intervals/trials/block_index/.zattrs.description: 0-indexed block number, increments with each block

intervals/trials/grating_phase/.zattrs.description: the phase of the visual grating shown in units of cycles; randomized over trials; for visual stimuli, this will be 0 or 0.5; for auditory stimuli, this will be nan

intervals/trials/is_aud_nontarget/.zattr.description: an auditory stimulus was presented that the subject should never respond to

intervals/trials/is_aud_stim/.zattrs.description: an auditory stimulus was presented; includes target and non-target stimuli; includes rewarded and non-rewarded trials; excludes catch trials (no stimulus)

intervals/trials/is_aud_target/.zattrs.description: an auditory stimulus was presented that the subject should respond to only in a specific block (context)

intervals/trials/is_block_switch/.zattrs.description: the first trial with a stimulus after a change in rewarded modality (context)

intervals/trials/is_contingent_reward/.z.description: the subject received a reward for a correct response

intervals/trials/is_correct/.zattrs.description: the subject acted correctly in the response window, according to its training; includes correct reject for catch trials

intervals/trials/is_correct_reject/.zatt.description: the subject did not respond in a NOGO trial; excludes catch trials

intervals/trials/is_false_alarm/.zattrs.description: the subject responded in a NOGO trial; excludes catch trials

intervals/trials/is_go/.zattrs.description: condition in which the subject should respond; target stim presented in rewarded block

intervals/trials/is_hit/.zattrs.description: the subject responded in a GO trial

intervals/trials/is_incorrect/.zattrs.description: the subject acted incorrectly in the response window, according to its training; includes false alarm for catch trials

intervals/trials/is_instruction/.zattrs.description: the stimulus presented was not random, but specifically chosen to inform the subject of a change in the rewarded stimulus modality (context)

intervals/trials/is_miss/.zattrs.description: the subject did not respond in a GO trial

intervals/trials/is_nogo/.zattrs.description: condition in which the subject should not respond; non-target stim presented in any block; target stim presented in non-rewarded block; excludes catch trials

intervals/trials/is_noncontingent_reward.description: the subject received a reward that did not depend on its response

intervals/trials/is_nontarget/.zattrs.description: a stimulus was presented that the subject should never respond to

intervals/trials/is_opto/.zattrs.description: optogenetic inactivation was applied during the trial

intervals/trials/is_repeat/.zattrs.description: the trial is a repetition of the previous trial, due to a miss

intervals/trials/is_response/.zattrs.description: the subject licked one or more times during the response window

intervals/trials/is_reward_scheduled/.za.description: a non-contingent reward was scheduled to occur, regardless of whether it was delivered; the subject may have responded correctly and received a contingent reward instead

intervals/trials/is_rewarded/.zattrs.description: the subject received a reward; includes non-contingent rewards

intervals/trials/is_target/.zattrs.description: a stimulus was presented that the subject should respond to only in a specific block (context)

intervals/trials/is_task_control_correct.description: the task control script interpreted the subject's response correctly; where `False`, other columns describing such as `is_hit` or `is_miss` reflect; may be incorrect due to latencies incurred by hardware or processing; may be incorrect due to bugs in the task control script

intervals/trials/is_vis_nontarget/.zattr.description: a visual stimulus was presented that the subject should never respond to

intervals/trials/is_vis_stim/.zattrs.description: a visual stimulus was presented; includes target and non-target stimuli; includes rewarded and non-rewarded trials; excludes catch trials (no stimulus)

intervals/trials/is_vis_target/.zattrs.description: a visual stimulus was presented that the subject should respond to only in a specific block (context)

intervals/trials/post_response_window_st.description: start of null interval in which the subject awaits a new trial; may receive a non-contingent reward if scheduled

intervals/trials/quiescent_start_time/.z.description: start of pre-stimulus interval in which the subject does not lick; a quiescent interval is enforced before each stimulus presentation; only the last quiescent interval (which was not violated) is included

intervals/trials/quiescent_stop_time/.za.description: end of pre-stimulus interval in which the subject does not lick; not equal to `stim_start_time`, which factors in processing and stimulus device latency

intervals/trials/repeat_index/.zattrs.description: number of times the trial has already been presented in immediately preceding trials; counts repeats due to misses; nan for catch trials

intervals/trials/response_time/.zattrs.description: time of first lick within the response window; nan if no lick occurred; may be nan even if `is_response` is True, for sessions prior to 2023-10-20 (see `task_control_response_time.description`)

intervals/trials/response_window_start_t.description: start of interval in which the subject should lick if a GO trial, otherwise should not lick

intervals/trials/response_window_stop_ti.description: end of interval in which the subject should lick if a GO trial, otherwise should not lick

intervals/trials/reward_time/.zattrs.description: delivery time of water reward, for contingent and non-contingent rewards

intervals/trials/rewarded_modality/.zatt.description: indicates the name of the rewarded modality in each block; not an exact correspondence with the values in `stim_name`

intervals/trials/start_time/.zattrs.description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

intervals/trials/stim_name/.zattrs.description: the stimulus presented; corresponds to a unique stimulus definition, randomized over trials

intervals/trials/stim_start_time/.zattrs.description: onset of visual or auditory stimulus

intervals/trials/stim_stop_time/.zattrs.description: offset of visual or auditory stimulus

intervals/trials/stop_time/.zattrs.description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

intervals/trials/task_control_response_t.description: time of first lick in trial, according to the task control script; a bug present until 2023-10-16 allowed a lick ocurring before `response_window_start_time` to be registered as a response, which then affected trial outcome; values in this column represent the time that the task control script registered as a response (regardless of whether the bug was present or not); nan if the task control script did not register a response

processing/behavior/eye_tracking/eye_hei.description: length of semi-minor axis of eye ellipse in pixels

processing/behavior/eye_tracking/eye_phi.description: counterclockwise rotation of major-axis of eye ellipse, relative to horizontal-axis of video, in radians

processing/behavior/eye_tracking/eye_wid.description: length of semi-major axis of eye ellipse in pixels

processing/behavior/eye_tracking/pupil_w.description: length of semi-major axis of pupil ellipse in pixels

processing/behavior/licks/.zattrs.description: times at which the subject made contact with a combined lick sensor + water spout: putatively the starts of licks, but may include other events such as grooming

processing/behavior/licks/duration/.zatt.description: duration of each lick sensor event, in seconds

processing/behavior/licks/is_likely_lick.description: boolean flag indicating whether lick sensor event duration is <=0.5, making it likely to be a true lick

processing/behavior/licks/timestamps/.za.description: time of lick sensor event onset, in seconds relative to session start time

processing/behavior/lp_front_camera/.zat.description: Lightning Pose tracking model fit to 12 facial features for each frame of front camera video. Output for every frame includes: `timestamps`: start time of frame exposure, in seconds | `<bodypart>_x` and `<bodypart>_y`: coordinates in pixels, with (0, 0) at top-left of frame | `<bodypart>_likelihood`: keypoint prediction likelihood between 0 and 1, with higher values representing greater confidence of the model | `<bodypart>_pca_error`: Euclidean distance in pixels between the original keypoint prediction and its prediction after projection to and from PCA space | `<bodypart>_temporal_norm`: Euclidean distance in pixels between keypoint predictions on successive time bins. See original publication for further details: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02319-1

processing/behavior/lp_side_camera/.zatt.description: Lightning Pose tracking model fit to 11 facial features for each frame of side camera video. Output for every frame includes: `timestamps`: start time of frame exposure, in seconds | `<bodypart>_x` and `<bodypart>_y`: coordinates in pixels, with (0, 0) at top-left of frame | `<bodypart>_likelihood`: keypoint prediction likelihood between 0 and 1, with higher values representing greater confidence of the model | `<bodypart>_pca_error`: Euclidean distance in pixels between the original keypoint prediction and its prediction after projection to and from PCA space | `<bodypart>_temporal_norm`: Euclidean distance in pixels between keypoint predictions on successive time bins. See original publication for further details: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02319-1

time at which the subject made contact with the lick spout during a pre-trial quiescent interval, triggering a restart of the trial

processing/behavior/rewards/.zattrs.description: water rewards delivered to the subject

processing/behavior/rewards/duration/.za.description: length of time the solenoid valve controlling water reward delivery to the subject was opened, in seconds

processing/behavior/rewards/is_solenoid_.description: boolean flag indicating that `timestamps` reflect solenoid opening times, rather than stimulus script trigger times (which do not account for all latencies in the reward delivery system)

processing/behavior/rewards/timestamps/..description: time at which the stimulus script triggered water rewards to be delivered to the subject

processing/behavior/running_speed/.zattr.description: linear forward running speed on a rotating disk, low-pass filtered at 4 Hz with a 3rd order Butterworth filter

units/activity_drift/.zattrs.description: a measure of activity drift over the behavior task trials (epochs.script_name == DynamicRouting1); `scipy.stats.anderson_ksamp()` is used to test whether spike counts within the interval [-1: 2] s around the stimulus start time in each block (grouped by context and stimulus) are drawn from the same distribution; the test statistic is normalized by dividing by 100 and clipping values to [0, 1], with 0 being the lowest activity drift; it is recommended to filter for units with a value below 0.1 for analyses that depend on stationary activity across the behvior task; for a manually-annotated subset of unit activity rasters, thresholding at 0.1 resulted in a true-positive rate of 99% and false-positive rate of ~30%; nan values indicate either that the unit had too few spikes to calculate the metric, or that the session had no behavior task trials

units/device_name/.zattrs.description: name in `devices` table of the probe that the unit was recorded on

units/electrode_group/.zattrs.description: the electrode group that each spike unit came from

units/is_not_drift/.zattrs.description: whether the unit has low activity drift (`activity_drift < 0.1`); false wherever `activity_drift` is nan

units/obs_intervals/.zattrs.description: the observation intervals for each unit

units/peak_electrode/.zattrs.description: index in `electrodes` table of channel with largest amplitude waveform

units/spike_times/.zattrs.description: the spike times for each unit
